title: 彭博经济学家曲天石：市场利率仍高，央行需释放更强信号
speaker: David Qu

segments.en: No, the reason why we say it's not low enough, because if you look at the, you cannot only look at the PBOC's policy rate. You need to also need to look at the market rate.
segments.zh: 不，我们说利率还不够低，是因为不能只看央行的政策利率，还要看市场利率。

segments.en: And if you look at the long rates and the market rate, it's still much higher than the return on asset. The company's return on asset or the household's rental yield much higher.
segments.zh: 长期利率和市场利率仍远高于资产回报率，企业资产回报率或家庭租金收益率都低得多。

segments.en: So that it means it has a lot of room to get lower. I mean the market rate. And the problem is how you can get the market rate lower?
segments.zh: 这意味着市场利率有很大下行空间。问题是如何让市场利率降下来？

segments.en: The PBOC need to show the attitude. To show their willingness to get the rates lower. How? Well, it's mechanism then, because they have the short end, which they're more focused on right now.
segments.zh: 央行需要表明态度，展示降低利率的意愿。怎么做？机制问题，他们目前更关注短端。
